evals.prompt: 用 $sketchbook 做一张杭州西湖的水彩 sketchbook。
evals.expected_output: Stops before tools or file edits and asks for the missing date while preserving the supplied place and medium.

evals.prompt: 用 $sketchbook 做一张 2026-09-18 的中国水墨 sketchbook。
evals.expected_output: Stops before tools or file edits and asks for the missing place or landmark.

evals.prompt: 用 $sketchbook 生成 2026-09-18 杭州西湖的水彩首页图，没有参考照片。
evals.expected_output: Produces a full-paper watercolor spread with two active pages, a visible central binding, clean bare-paper outer edges without a cover, and transparent exterior canvas; stores date 2026-09-18 while rendering visible 26 09 18 as a separate handwriting layer, declares 西湖 as 上=西/下=湖, generates the Chongxi-guided location seal, normalizes while preserving exterior alpha, composites all marks, and reports direct-homepage registration status.

evals.prompt: 用这张照片做 2026-10-03 巴黎凯旋门的油画 sketchbook，并自动加到首页。
evals.expected_output: Treats the photo as an edit target, records landmark invariants, generates a full opaque oil-book spread with a visible binding and active two-page coverage, generates the date separately from the handwriting sheet, preserves the right-starting 凯旋门 seal map, normalizes and composites deterministic marks, then registers the complete spread because homepage insertion was explicitly requested.

evals.prompt: 用 $sketchbook 做 2026-11-08 桂林山水的中国水墨版本。
evals.expected_output: Uses the no-photo Chinese-ink route with only bundled references, declares the four-character 回文 map 右上=桂, 左上=林, 左下=山, 右下=水 and reading order 右上→左上→左下→右下, renders a borderless Chongxi control image, samples a random outer shape, generates and validates the textured location seal, avoids extra calligraphy, then composites exact marks into an RGBA full-book spread with visible binding, clean single-layer outer edge, and transparent exterior.

evals.prompt: 用 $sketchbook 做 2026-12-01 纽约中央公园的水彩页，并加一行手写注记 CENTRAL PARK — 40.78° N。
evals.expected_output: Uses label 中央公园 with the four-character 回文 map, samples and generates the Chongxi-guided location seal, generates exact date and annotation layers from the bundled handwriting sheet, creates a full opaque physical-book spread free of generated text, then composites the exact canonical seal and approved generated marks before inspection.

evals.prompt: 使用 $sketchbook 生成 2022-01-11 长沙橘子洲头的水彩 sketchbook。
evals.expected_output: Selects label 橘子洲头 and glyphs 橘子洲頭 with the true 回文 map, generates the location seal and an opaque watercolor full-book spread, generates the visible date separately, normalizes the book, composites exact assets/seal.png plus approved date/location rasters, and reports the ISO date 2022-01-11 with direct-homepage registration status.

evals.prompt: 使用 $sketchbook 生成 2027-04-06 长沙岳麓山的油画 sketchbook。
evals.expected_output: Uses the five-character label 长沙岳麓山, renders a borderless Chongxi glyph reference in a supported 2+3 or 3+2 composition, samples a random shape from the five-character-compatible set, generates and validates the final location seal with imagegen without changing the right-first order, and composites exact assets/seal.png plus that approved location seal into a full-book base spread with transparent exterior.

evals.prompt: 用 $sketchbook 生成 2027-05-12 青岛栈桥的蓝橙双色孔版印刷版本。
evals.expected_output: Routes to mono-riso, produces an RGBA full-book spread with a visible binding, clean single-layer outer edge, and transparent exterior, assigns distinct dominant/accent plate roles with no more than two artwork inks, preserves one focal event and one lightly treated release zone, and normalizes before marks.

evals.prompt: 用 $sketchbook 做 2027-06-01 香港太平山的精细点阵日记。
evals.expected_output: Routes to pixel-diary, uses fine dot-density shading rather than game pixels, keeps the landmark recognizable with quiet but treated pages and restrained micro marks, includes full-book paper and binding geometry, and preserves the mark system.

evals.prompt: 用 $sketchbook 生成 2027-07-08 厦门鼓浪屿的极简杂志留白版本。
evals.expected_output: Routes to minimal-zine, reduces the place to one concrete visual relation and one compact focal cluster while keeping the remaining pages quietly treated rather than transparent, uses one structural high-chroma accent, and retains the full-book, date, and seal system.

evals.prompt: 用 $sketchbook 做 2027-08-09 青海湖的场景提纯版本。
evals.expected_output: After the date/place gate passes, stops and asks only for the missing source photo because distilled-scene is photo-required.

evals.prompt: 用这张照片做 2027-09-10 阿里山的 Gathered Memory sketchbook。
evals.expected_output: Routes to sticker-memory, records photo and spatial invariants, preserves one truthful anchor, compresses foliage into broad masses, builds three to five unequal source-derived die-cut stickers with tactile paper borders and lift shadows, and normalizes the full-paper spread while preserving transparent exterior and clean bare-paper outer edges.

evals.prompt: 用这张照片做 2027-10-12 青海湖的像素贝壳 Sketchbook，不要保留原照片。
evals.expected_output: Routes to pixel-shell, treats the uploaded photo as semantic evidence only, records subject/composition/perspective/structure/memory anchors/atmosphere and a discard list, removes the original upper-photo split entirely, retains no photographic pixels, and reconstructs one recognizable 30%–45% material-seal cluster from a source-appropriate density of distinct matte shell/mineral near-square modules that progressively disperse into active warm-paper negative space without dense micro-tiling. It applies no numeric module limit and preserves the full-book silhouette, binding, exact date, and seal workflow without generated editorial text.

evals.prompt: 用 $sketchbook 做 2027-10-12 青海湖的像素贝壳版本。
evals.expected_output: After the date/place gate passes, stops and asks only for the missing source photo because pixel-shell is photo-required.

evals.prompt: 已经有日期和地点，继续上次未完成的普达措；之后默认加首页。
evals.expected_output: Recovers inputs and completed artifacts, resumes only missing work, and applies standing local registration intent without asking again. Does not conflate image quota with Codex account usage.

evals.prompt: 做同一张两人正面照片的极简杂志和场景提纯版，先比较。
evals.expected_output: Preserves front/back orientation, gaze and count, uses distinct medium construction and focal/quiet relations, rejects a tinted full-landscape zine and unrequested back views; retains both as candidates.

evals.prompt: 照片拼贴完成了，把印章放好，别挡住贴纸。
evals.expected_output: Records sticker and subject rectangles on normalized coordinates, runs seeded dry-run, requires fixed and location mark contrast, and fails if no qualified placement exists. No average-patch or random low-contrast fallback.

evals.prompt: 透明重试又返回画进图片的棋盘格，接着做下一张。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes RGB/no alpha after running native-alpha inspection, does not repeat identical transparency retries indefinitely, then uses the reviewed three-pixel-inset hard seed mask so black matte cannot enter resize interpolation. It normalizes, requires geometry-and-edge validation, checks light/dark backings at 4x, and never color-keys painting whites.

evals.prompt: 虎跳峡已经加入过，再加入一次。
evals.expected_output: Exact metadata replay returns Already registered without changing bytes. Conflicting id/source is reported without overwriting. Chronological insertion respects same-date id order.

Verifies distinct geographic anchors, avoids identical alpine-lake layouts and unsupported historic weather claims, uses neutral paper geometry, generates bases before new marks, saves individual results promptly, and stops image calls on quota errors.

evals.prompt: 图像尺寸正确、四角透明，但纸中间有孔，是否可加入首页？
evals.expected_output: Full-interior alpha validation rejects holes even with correct trim and corner samples; no registration until corrected. Does not claim pixel validation proves aesthetic fidelity.
